sources.title: CBC — Watsonville field-day handout, May 8, 2026
sources.enumerated_scope: All 15 original pages, including five photo-only pages; fourteen named CBC products or trial selections. The printed May 8 date is the field-day date, not a verified publication date.
sources.limitations: Bounded handout only; not a complete historical or worldwide portfolio. Sweet Carolina is on the website but not named here. Outside comparators and anonymous competitor labels are excluded, not assigned to CBC. UC Victor and Victor remain separate literal labels without alias approval. Dunsmuir / CBC029 / 118.060-601 must stay distinct from CBC030 / 118.066-601. Marketing access, acreage, performance and nursery wording do not approve traits, roles, regions or current rights. Printed patent numbers are linked through separately checked originals. Five photo-only pages were read visually; PDF pages are not hosted image assets. Elcano’s 2025 yield prose and table differ; no numeric trait imported.
